content:
{
  "findings": [
    {
      "title": "Secondary endpoint for safety lacks stated analysis",
      "quote": "AEs, serious adverse events (SAEs), and AEs leading to discontinuation or death, and severity of AEs as assessed by the National Cancer Institute (NCI) Common Terminology Criteria for Adverse Events version 5.0 (CTCAE v5.0)",
      "page": 33,
      "section": "2.2.2 Secondary Endpoints",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The safety endpoint is listed but no specific statistical analysis method is described for it in the statistical methods section; only general safety analyses are mentioned.",
      "fix": "Add a detailed analysis description for safety endpoints, including AE incidence, severity grading, and handling of missing data."
    },
    {
      "title": "Secondary endpoint for non-injected target lesions lacks stated analysis",
      "quote": "Treatment response in non-injected target lesions based on RECIST v1.1 by BICR",
      "page": 33,
      "section": "2.2.2 Secondary Endpoints",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "This secondary endpoint is not addressed in the efficacy analyses section; only exploratory analyses for non-injected lesions are mentioned.",
      "fix": "Specify the analysis method for this secondary endpoint, including how response in non-injected target lesions will be summarized and tested."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing estimand attributes for primary endpoint",
      "quote": "The primary endpoint of the study is the ORR, defined as the proportion of subjects with a confirmed objective response of CR or PR based on RECIST v1.1 as determined by Blinded Independent Central Review (BICR).",
      "page": 33,
      "section": "2.2.1 Primary Endpoint",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The estimand for the primary endpoint is incomplete: it lacks specification of the population (ITT is mentioned later but not tied to the estimand), intercurrent events (e.g., treatment discontinuation, death), and summary measure (proportion is implied but not formally defined).",
      "fix": "Define the estimand for the primary endpoint including population, variable, intercurrent events strategy, and summary measure."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing analysis for PK endpoint",
      "quote": "Blood concentrations of CMP-001 or its metabolites",
      "page": 33,
      "section": "2.2.2 Secondary Endpoints",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The PK endpoint is listed but no corresponding statistical analysis is described in the statistical methods section.",
      "fix": "Add a PK analysis section detailing how concentrations will be summarized, PK parameters estimated, and missing data handled."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing analysis for immunogenicity endpoint",
      "quote": "Development of anti-Qb antibodies",
      "page": 33,
      "section": "2.2.2 Secondary Endpoints",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The immunogenicity endpoint is listed but no analysis method is provided in the statistical methods section.",
      "fix": "Specify the analysis for anti-Qb antibodies, including incidence, titers, and relationship to safety/efficacy."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing analysis for exploratory biomarker endpoints",
      "quote": "Baseline, and change from Baseline, in tumor or blood measurements of biomarkers related to TLR9, immune checkpoints, and potential markers of resistance or response to immunotherapy",
      "page": 34,
      "section": "2.2.3 Exploratory Endpoints",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The exploratory biomarker endpoints are listed but no statistical analysis is described in the statistical methods section.",
      "fix": "Add an exploratory analysis section for biomarker endpoints, including descriptive statistics and any inferential methods."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing analysis for CXCL10 and cytokine endpoint",
      "quote": "Change from Baseline in blood concentrations of CXCL10 (interferon gamma-induced protein 10) and other cytokines after treatment with CMP-001",
      "page": 34,
      "section": "2.2.3 Exploratory Endpoints",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "This exploratory endpoint is not addressed in the statistical methods section.",
      "fix": "Specify the analysis for cytokine changes, including timepoints, summary measures, and handling of missing data."
    },
    {
      "title": "Sample size inconsistency: 69 vs 100 subjects",
      "quote": "A sample size of 69 subjects achieves at least 90% power to detect a difference of 13% using a 2-sided exact test with a significance level of 0.05, assuming that the null hypothesis for ORR is 7% (Hodi-2016; Ribas-2018), and the study ORR is 20%. The sample size was increased to 100 subjects to adjust for an early discontinuation rate of 15% and to allow for a robust assessment of safety.",
      "page": 80,
      "section": "9.1 Sample Size Calculation",
      "category": "consistency",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "The sample size calculation is based on 69 subjects, but the study enrolls 100. The text explains the increase, but the power statement is based on 69, which may be confusing; ensure the power for 100 is also stated.",
      "fix": "Clarify the power achieved with the final sample size of 100 subjects, or state that the power is based on the evaluable sample of 69."
    }
  ]
}
